description: Na₂LaZr(PO₄)₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.94 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.89 Å. La is bonded to six O atoms to form LaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.40 Å. Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.24 Å. There are three inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-36°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.59 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-42°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.58 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-43°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.59 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one La, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one La and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Zr and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one La, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one La, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Zr, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Zr, and one P atom.
